text_block_list.text: Whaaat――?!
Ryaaah!!!
(BAAAAM!!)

A tremendous noise echoed from an arcade I 
was passing by. Curious, I peeked inside—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's no good. I just cannot beat the 
first-place score no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I cannot surrender. Surely this 
hardship is but a noblewoman's duty――

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I will make sure to claim the top spot. 
With this "Umamusume-Exclusive Punching 
Machine"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good day to you, Academy Trainer. 
Naturally, of course.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess must always remain strong. 
This too is an indispensable part of my 
royal training!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! A princess is someone who stands 
alongside her prince. Fighting together, 
and at times even rescuing the prince from 
danger—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To achieve that: first is stamina, second 
is arm strength. And so! I'd like to ask 
your advice.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Could you give me a hint on how to beat 
the number-one score on the punching 
machine?
choice_data_list: Make the next one your final shot!

Maybe try visualizing the opponent you 
need to defeat?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I see! A formidable rival who gets back up 
no matter how many times you knock them 
down――

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So you mean to say... if I wish to bring 
them down, I must resolve myself that the 
next strike will be my last.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In that case—allow me to show you a 
princess's true power! Here I cooome!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "Shiny Princess Explosive Buster Attack!"
(KABOOOOM!!)

A right straight swung with a mysterious 
catchphrase. The record was brilliantly 
shattered!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, punching a machine blindly really 
doesn't put one's heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case... Here I come, my 
Prince!!
choice_data_list: You're gonna take down the prince?!
You're gonna take down the prince?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! What kind of princess would I 
be if I couldn't surpass a prince with my 
own two fists? Now, behold my true power!

A princess challenging a prince is quite 
unorthodox, but... she must have her own 
vision of what a princess should be.
